# TnC Tax & Consulting Website Project

This is a modern NextJS + TypeScript project for a tax and consulting website with the following features:
- Mobile-responsive design
- Content management dashboard
- Backend API integration ready
- Modern and professional UI/UX

## Project Structure
- Home page with company information (mission, vision, values, memberships)
- Services pages (Accounting, Finance, Tax, Legal, HR)
- News/Blog section
- Careers page
- Contact page
- Admin dashboard for content management

## Development Guidelines
- Use TypeScript for all components
- Follow responsive design principles
- Implement modern UI patterns
- Prepare for backend API integration
- Focus on professional, clean design suitable for corporate clients
